supervisor_sizing.entry: 2 tranches: half after the Q3 print (likely 2026-11-04), half after FY2027 guidance (Jan-Feb 2027), only if price is at or below ~$280 or estimates rise, and only if the owner accepts the A&D/defense exposure
supervisor_sizing.overlap: AVGO and GOOGL (AI/semis capex; semis ~54% of MTRN net sales); VST (AI data-centre build-out). None with NFLX or BKNG. Live book: AVGO 2, GOOGL 3, VST 5, NFLX 11, BKNG 6 shares plus ~$7,600 cash (~$10,000).
supervisor_sizing.reason: After the checks, fair value (~$258) sits ~17% below spot and the 39x multiple is an unjustified premium to peers. With ~55-60% volatility, beating SPY's Sharpe needs roughly +25-30%, and my ladder gives P(>= $375) ~28% and P(>= $421) ~20%. It would be a third AI-capex bet in a small book and carries defense-rule ambiguity, so cap it as a small satellite.
supervisor_sizing.conviction_label_reason: The checked evidence shows good fundamentals already more than priced: 39x against a ~29x peer median with below-peer ROIC and growth, and fair value ~$258 below the $312 spot. So there is no expected-return edge over the S&P 500 for the next 12 months.

method: Suggested allocation from the cash to deploy: one joint solve over every name (optimize.py), run after combine.py.

risk_model.note: Annualized vol of the whole account (holdings + all suggested buys, rest in cash): blended vols, recalibrated factor-model correlations.
